conditions: Adult female paratype SAMA R72337 of Litoria kikori sp. nov. (the only female in the type series). Table 1 header as returned by the page reader: line 1 'SAMA (South Australian Museum) | R69990 | R72336 | R69989 | R69986 | QMJ 98371 | R69987 | R69991 |'; line 2 'PNGNM (Papua New Guinea National Museum) | R69988 | R69992 | R72337 | Mean | SD | Min'; Sex row 'M M M M M M M M M M F males only'. Eight specimen values sit in the first line (the eighth is the PNGNM specimen, which carries no catalogue number in the header) and R69988, R69992, R72337 follow in the second, then Mean, SD and Min-Max for males only. Type status: SAMA R69990 is the holotype ('SAMA (South Australian Museum) R69990 (SJR[JCUNQ]3245), adult male with vocal slits and nuptial pads'); R72337 is a female paratype ('SAMA (South Australian Museum) R72336 (SJR14135), male, and R72337 (SJR14141), female, Bifo Creek, Southern Highlands Province, Papua New Guinea (6.4483°S, 142.9597°E; 360 m a.s.l.), collected by Stephen Richards on 2 and 4 August 2014 respectively.'). The quote is the whole row with cells joined by single spaces; the record uses the column named. Preserved museum specimen.
